headline: Session banked, but it's roughly a third of what was prescribed
summary: Prescribed was 1h50 Z2 (142-152bpm) rolling with ~450m D+. Actual: 53min TrailRun, 396m D+, avg HR 136bpm — comfortably in band and cadence/effort easy (RPE 4, feel 4) — but roughly half the time and D+ of the brief, plus a 42min e-bike spin tacked on before it. HRV 62 and RHR 51 this morning (RHR still elevated post-Brendola travel, which is noise at this point, not a worry) meant the stop-rule wasn't even triggered — this was a time-box or route-length call, not a physiology-gated cutback. No pain or ITB signal reported. Net effect: today lands around 57 load vs the 120 planned, continuing last week's pattern of trimming the easy/aerobic days short.
flags: This is the second week-5/6 session this block finishing meaningfully under prescribed duration (Fri 16 Oct was also 36min vs 59) — worth naming as a pattern rather than one-offs, since the stimulus for Sunday was explicitly 'back-to-back on tired legs' for VWT's second half.
CTL ramp still fine (53.1, well under the 6/wk cap), so no load alarm — but the shortfall banks less aerobic durability work than the plan intended heading into the Specific block.
suggestedChange: Consider either extending tomorrow's easy session slightly to recover some of today's missed volume, or just noting today as absorbed and moving on — but worth flagging explicitly to Alberto that sub-60min 'easy' days are recurring versus the written duration, independent of readiness gates.
